metadata.description: CandleKeep gives your AI agents a library they can actually read. Install the Claude Code plugin or the Claude Cowork plugin to research your own PDFs and markdown documents with page-level citations, browse and subscribe to marketplace books, and write knowledge documents back to your library.

plugins.name: candlekeep-cloud
plugins.description: AI agent access to your CandleKeep Cloud document library in Claude Code. Spawns librarian, item-reader, book-writer and book-enricher sub-agents to research your books and answer with page-level citations, backed by the `ck` CLI.

plugins.name: candlekeep-cowork
plugins.description: AI agent access to your CandleKeep document library in Claude Cowork. Bundles the candlekeep skill, four specialist sub-agents (librarian, item-reader, book-writer, book-enricher) and the hosted CandleKeep MCP connector, so research, marketplace subscriptions and document writing all work with no local CLI or filesystem.
